case_number: 2024 INSC 501; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 7256-7259 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 7260-7264 OF 2024
summary: Dispute over continuity of teaching staff after lease termination; AWES takeover of St. Gabriel's Academy; service conditions vs financial viability; dual service conditions impermissible; seniority and terminal dues addressed; amicable resolution ordered with agreed terms framework; contempt proceedings stayed pending settlement.
final_judgment: Appeals disposed of by directing parties to resolve dispute amicably through meeting within one week; service continuity maintained; next hearing scheduled for 2021-03-22.
